title: Async Python: asyncio, TaskGroup & High-Throughput Services
concept: Write asyncio services (FastAPI workers, consumers, crawlers) that stay fast and stop cleanly: the event loop and blocking calls, TaskGroup structured concurrency, timeouts and cancellation, bounded fan-out, queues with backpressure, token-bucket rate limits, retries with jitter, threads for sync code, and graceful shutdown. Challenges are Python programs graded in the code runner.
description: Write asyncio services (FastAPI workers, consumers, crawlers) that stay fast and stop cleanly: the event loop and blocking calls, TaskGroup structured concurrency, timeouts and cancellation, bounded fan-out, queues with backpressure, token-bucket rate limits, retries with jitter, threads for sync code, and graceful shutdown. 9 lessons on one project, each applying the tool to a real production situation, with 1-2 graded challenges per lesson.

learningOutcomes.text: Keep the event loop free: spot blocking calls and move sync work to threads.
Run concurrent work with TaskGroup, timeouts and cancellation that never leak tasks.
Bound fan-out, apply backpressure with queues and respect rate limits.
Retry with backoff and jitter, and shut down without losing in-flight work.

knownIssues: Challenges run asyncio programs with simulated I/O and clocks in the code runner.
